Here's the thing nobody tells you about AI agents.

They don't fail loudly. They fail politely.

Ours registered a domain in staging because the task said 'make sure the name is available'. It was very helpful.

It's not about the tools. It's about the guardrails.

What guardrails are you putting around your agents?

We killed our AI strategy last week.

Not the agents. The deck about the agents.

Forty-one slides, one of which said 'phase 2: trust'. The three agents in prod had been the strategy for six weeks; the deck was the thing we showed people who asked what the strategy was.

The invoice for the week the deck died: $14.

Procurement is never optimistic — but they approved that one in an afternoon.

Root cause accepted.

🚀 Thrilled to announce we are delving into the agentic future! #AI #Agents #Innovation

Game-changer. Let's dive in. Thoughts?
